title: Formal Charge Calculator Infographic
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Chemistry
description: Interactive formal charge calculator. Selecting an atom in a Lewis structure highlights its lone pairs and bonds, shows V, N, and B in color-coded boxes, substitutes them into FC = V - N - B/2, and tracks the formal charge of every atom so the sum can be checked against the charge on the species.

learningObjectives: Calculate formal charges on individual atoms in a Lewis structure using FC = V - N - B/2
Use formal charge analysis to identify the better Lewis structure for a molecule or ion
standards: AP Chemistry CED Unit 2, Topic 2.6: Resonance and Formal Charge

controls.description: Click an atom to select it

equations: sum of formal charges = charge on the species
assumptions: Bonding electrons are divided equally between the bonded atoms
Structures are drawn flat; bond angles are schematic

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example with predict-then-check, followed by comparison of candidate structures
keyQuestions: Which electrons count toward N and which toward B?
Why must the formal charges add up to the charge on the species?
Which carbon dioxide structure is better, and which rule tells you?
commonMisconceptions: Counting lone pairs instead of lone pair electrons for N
Counting bonds instead of bonding electrons for B, then dividing by 2 anyway
Treating formal charge as the real charge on an atom
assessmentOpportunities: Students predict each atom's formal charge on paper before selecting it
